name: opencode-go
description: Lets Claude delegate tasks to OpenCode Go, Zen and Z.AI Coding Plan models, picked in an OpenCode panel with FREE, PAID and Z.AI PLAN sections and a reasoning level, and ask local decision models (Kev, Laya) quick questions.

defaultModel.title: Default OpenCode Go model
defaultModel.description: Worker used until one is picked in the OpenCode panel (provider/model, or a bare id under opencode-go/).

orchestrate.title: Encourage delegation
orchestrate.description: Adds a short system prompt section telling Claude to hand routine work to OpenCode workers.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model a run switches to after the picked one keeps failing (429s, hangs). Empty: no fallback.

autoRetries.title: Automatic resumes
autoRetries.description: How many times a failed or hung opencode run is resumed before giving up (and trying the fallback model).

stallMinutes.title: Stall limit (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A run that prints nothing for this long is killed and resumed.

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudget.description: No new paid runs start once today's OpenCode spend reaches this. 0: no limit.

reviewModel.title: Review model
reviewModel.description: Model that reviews batch tasks (delegate_batch with review: true, or goal mode). auto: Gemini when the Google AI Pro plan is connected through Antigravity, else a free model.

zaiQuota.title: Z.AI quota (model calls per 5 hours)
zaiQuota.description: Runs on Z.AI Coding Plan models stop starting once the last 5 hours reach this many model calls (each step a worker takes is one). The plan counts prompts, so set this from what you see in your z.ai usage page. 0: no limit.

localModelsDir.title: Local models folder
localModelsDir.description: Folder holding the kev checkout (kev/.venv) and the Laya venv (laya-env). Empty: ~/local-models.

kevModel.title: Kev checkpoint
kevModel.description: Hub id or local folder Kev serves. kev-0.8b fits a 4 GB GPU; kev-4b wants about 16 GB.

localDevice.title: Kev device
localDevice.description: auto, cuda or cpu, for Kev.

layaDevice.title: Laya device
layaDevice.description: auto, cuda or cpu, for Laya. cpu (the default) leaves the GPU to Kev; Laya is fast enough there.

kevGpuGb.title: Kev GPU budget (GiB)
kevGpuGb.description: Above 0: Kev's layers fill this much of the GPU and the rest run from system RAM, so a model larger than the card still runs (slower). 0: Kev runs whole on one device.
